evidence_at_a_glance.population: Efficacy-evaluable cohorts: 33 metastatic and 63 locally advanced BCC cases; 104 patients were treated overall.
evidence_at_a_glance.comparison: No control arm; two separate nonrandomised cohorts.
evidence_at_a_glance.applicability: Independent-review update at 21 months after the last patient was enrolled, reported in EMA Table 2 and the 2015 trial update; this is not 21 months of treatment for every patient.

endpoints.outcome: Confirmed objective response: locally advanced BCC

limitations: A single-arm response rate is not a cure rate or proof of comparative survival benefit.
Metastatic RECIST 1.0 and locally advanced composite/biopsy response assessments differ.
Do not combine the independent 21-month results with original 9-month or investigator-assessed 39-month results.
harms: Muscle spasms, taste change, hair loss, appetite/weight effects and tiredness may affect continued treatment.
Current severe-skin, pregnancy-prevention and other safety requirements come from the current NCCP/SmPC, not solely from the original trial.

sources.label: ERIVANCE primary report, Sekulic et al., NEJM 2012
ERIVANCE 12-month update, Sekulic et al., JAAD 2015
EMA Erivedge SmPC, section 5.1 and Table 2, pp10-11
ERIVANCE final investigator-assessed update, Sekulic et al., BMC Cancer 2017

evidence_audit.status: Primary trial and current EMA outcome reconciliation complete; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
indications_reviewed: NCCP 00236a: adults with symptomatic metastatic BCC
NCCP 00236b: adults with locally advanced BCC inappropriate for surgery or radiotherapy
evidence_audit.coverage_summary: Both advanced BCC cohorts are covered. The original 9-month independent analysis, subsequent independent update at 21 months after last enrolment, and investigator analysis at 39 months are attributed separately.
evidence_audit.later_or_add_on_search: The 2015 independent-review update and 2017 final investigator-assessed publication were checked alongside current EMA Table 2. This bounded audit does not establish an optimal sequence against other systemic treatments.
remaining_uncertainties: No randomised comparator or causal comparative survival estimate.
Small, selected cohorts with different response criteria.
Independent clinical/pharmacy and patient/PPI review remain pending.

treatment_rationale_factors_replace: Histologically confirmed basal cell carcinoma and exact advanced-disease setting
Whether surgery or radiotherapy is appropriate, and the multidisciplinary assessment
Earlier treatment, organ function, pregnancy-prevention requirements, toxicity and patient priorities
treatment_rationale_limitations_replace: Source-reconciled efficacy estimates describe the enrolled advanced BCC cohorts; they do not predict an individual response or establish comparative survival benefit. Irish use remains governed by the current NCCP indication. Independent clinical and pharmacy review is separate from this evidence reconciliation.
